Internal helper: the variables a range in a one-variable slot names

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_slot_range_names.Rd

For the slots that take ONE variable, and jrelabel()'s variable slot (Session 430, the (S429) range item): a range A:B read against the data frame as every variable list reads it since ruling R90 – every variable from its first end to its last, through .jst_resolve_varrange(), so an end that is not a variable takes the not-found sentence and ends the wrong way round take the stop that turns them. A range inside c() is not read so, as ruling R90 keeps it on the not-found stop in every variable list; nor is a range of numbers (1:3). Anything else, or no data frame, gives NULL, and the caller reads the slot as before.

Usage

.jst_slot_range_names(ex, data, data_name = NULL, default_used = FALSE)

Arguments

ex

The slot as typed.

data

The data frame, or NULL.

data_name, default_used

As .jst_resolve_varrange().

Value

Character, the names in the data frame's order, or NULL.
